query: I have a question: I don't have a marriage certificate to apply for an OCI for my minor child. Are there any alternative documents that can be used instead of a marriage certificate?
expected_key_facts: For a minor OCI applicant (foreign national previously holding an Indian passport), item 10 of the mandatory documents is 'Marriage Certificate of Parents': if the marriage was solemnized in India, a Marriage Certificate issued by the Marriage Registrar is required (a certificate issued by a religious body is not acceptable).

The only stated alternatives to the parents' marriage certificate are condition-based: if the parents are divorced, a copy of the divorce decree may be provided instead; if one parent is not alive, a copy of the death certificate may be provided instead.
The substituted document (divorce decree or death certificate) must be self-attested.

If the marriage certificate or divorce decree was issued outside India, it must be apostilled or attested by the issuing country's authority (e.g. the County/Municipality office in the US state or city where it was issued) -- self-attested copies of the apostilled document should be sent, not original apostilled documents.

query: I was referring the attestation page, I will be needing my copy of passport, copy of my VISA, copy of my I797, copy of my USA Address proof to be attested by Indian embassy for submitting these to an Indian bank - Question: Should I need to only send all the copy of the documents to embassy for attestation or all original documents (or) all copy documents notarized only
expected_key_facts: For attestation of documents issued by US authorities (e.g. US passport, driving licence) or copies of Indian passport/OCI card for use in India, applicants should attach clear NOTARISED photocopies of the passport, address proof, and legal status documents -- not original documents.
Acceptable proof of US address (any one, notarized): US Driving License, Utility Bill, Lease Agreement, State Identity Card, or Mortgage Deed.

Acceptable proof of US visa status (any one, notarized): the visa page of the passport (H1B, H4, L1, L2, etc.), Green Card, Employment Authorization Document, or I-797/I-140/I-20 (with a handwritten note on regularization efforts if approval is pending).

Fee: US$10.00 per page (payable to Consulate General of India) plus a separate US$2.00 ICWF fee per application, payable only by money order or cashier's cheque; processing takes 5-7 working days from receipt of a complete application.
